welcomeText: Over 6 years shipping production mobile apps for fintech, social and logistics platforms. I care about clean architecture, smooth UI and getting things through App Store review without losing my mind.
skillsDescription: Six years of experience with React Native and TypeScript, building and shipping production applications across fintech, social networking, logistics, and live streaming. Experienced in owning features end to end, from architecture and implementation to production releases on the App Store and Google Play.
aboutCard1: Over 6 years building and shipping production mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript, working across fintech, social networking, logistics, and live streaming.
aboutCard2: I specialize in taking mobile features from architecture to production — designing maintainable solutions, integrating APIs and native SDKs, handling platform-specific requirements, and shipping reliable releases to the App Store and Google Play.
aboutCard3: I care about clean architecture, thoughtful technical decisions, performance, security, and a smooth user experience. I also enjoy the engineering side of the work: reviewing code, defining standards, breaking down complex problems, and helping other developers grow.
aboutText1: My experience goes beyond implementation. I contribute to architecture and technical decisions, review code, delegate work, establish engineering standards, and help build codebases that are easier to maintain and scale.
aboutText2: I started in JavaScript and web development in 2018 before moving into React Native and making mobile engineering my focus. Since then, I've worked on applications ranging from financial and identity flows to logistics, social platforms, and native device integrations.
aboutText3: I like solving complex mobile problems, keeping the architecture clean, and shipping software that actually works in production.

faq.q: Is he available for new work?
faq.a: Yes. He is open to freelance or contract work and to full-time roles. Reach him through the Contact screen, by email at joaovitorspereira@gmail.com, or with the book_intro tool of the MCP server.

faq.a: Yes. It exposes llms.txt, a JSON Resume file, WebMCP tools in the browser and a remote MCP server with the tools get_resume, get_projects, check_availability and book_intro.
